**[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13)): DC 45 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 43 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 40 [Ticktock](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2569) **Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 53 **Perception** +27; echolocation 120 feet, no vision, painsense **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Infernal](/Languages.aspx?ID=19), [Shadowtongue](/Languages.aspx?ID=21) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +32, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +30, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +31, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +30, [Torture Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +29 **Str** +6 **Dex** +8 **Con** +6 **Int** +5 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +0 **Echolocation** Ticktock can use his hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.
**Painsense** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48)) Ticktock automatically knows whether a creature he hears has any of the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9), [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11), or [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=42) conditions, as well as the value of those conditions. **Items** [_The Forge_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2506) --- **AC** 40 **Fort** +28 **Ref** +30 **Will** +25 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=103) **HP** 275 , regeneration 15 (deactivated by good or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379)) **Immunities** [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1), [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) **Weaknesses** good 15, silver 15 **Tick Tock Tick Tock** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, the constant clicking and ticking sounds coming from Ticktock worm into its thoughts and fill the listener with the sense that time is speeding up for everyone but itself. The creature must succeed at a DC 34 Will save or become [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) (or slowed 2 on a critical failure) until the end of its next turn.
**[Attack of Opportunity](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=3)** --- **Speed** 25 feet, climb 25 feet **Melee** tool fingers +32 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Evil](/Traits.aspx?ID=64), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)), **Damage** 3d4+14 piercing plus 1d6 evil and 2d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Divine Innate Spells** DC 37 - **3rd** [Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110) - **8th** [Chilling Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=36) **Shadow Scream** ([Aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=39), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) The sacristan opens their mouth to unloose a series of thunderous clicking sounds. This creates a 30-foot emanation of darkness and wailing sounds around the sacristan. Creatures with [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) can't see through this darkness. The sacristan can Sustain Shadow Scream for up to 1 minute. Non-[velstrac](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=111) creatures in the area when the ability is used, as well as those who enter or start their turn in the area, must attempt a DC 37 Will save.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.
**Success** The creature is [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5) and deafened for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** The creature takes 20 mental damage, and is confused and deafened for 1 round.
name: Ticktock
